name: The Gordunni Orb
summary: After Dark Ceremony, Rok Orhan sends you to Orgrimmar with the Gordunni Orb. Uthel'nay at Darkbriar Lodge can judge its power.

sections.title: Beyond a Warrior's Knowledge
sections.body: After Dark Ceremony, Rok Orhan holds the Gordunni Orb. He knows the Gordunni well, but a warrior cannot judge the orb's power. So he sends you to Orgrimmar with it. There, Uthel'nay at Darkbriar Lodge can tell you more.

sections.title: Uthel'nay's Verdict
sections.body: Uthel'nay finds the Gordunni Orb fascinating. The mage says it is very powerful and very dangerous.

faq.answer: After you bring back the orb from Dark Ceremony, Rok Orhan sends you to Uthel'nay.

faq.q: Why does Rok Orhan not examine the orb?
aliases: why rok orhan gives orb away
faq.answer: Rok Orhan knows the Gordunni well, but as a warrior she cannot judge the orb's power. She knows a mage in Orgrimmar who can tell you more.
Uthel'nay is at Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What comes before The Gordunni Orb?
faq.answer: Dark Ceremony comes first. Rok Orhan sent you to take an orb from a Gordunni mage-lord.
